assertions.name: 行数 = sessions 行数
assertions.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_session_risk_summary) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sessions)

assertions.name: 主键/来源列无 NULL
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_session_risk_summary WHERE session_id IS NULL OR source_ip IS NULL

assertions.name: 事件总数 = attack_log 行数
assertions.sql: SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(event_count), 0) FROM v_session_risk_summary) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attack_log)

assertions.name: 重算风险分与存储分无漂移
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_session_risk_summary WHERE stored_max_risk_score <> calculated_risk_score

assertions.name: 行数 = attacker_profile 行数
assertions.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_attacker_profile_summary) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attacker_profile)

assertions.name: 画像/来源列无 NULL
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_attacker_profile_summary WHERE attacker_id IS NULL OR source_ip IS NULL

assertions.name: risk_level 与重算分数阈值一致
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_attacker_profile_summary WHERE CASE WHEN calculated_risk_score >= 80 THEN 'critical' WHEN calculated_risk_score >= 60 THEN 'high' WHEN calculated_risk_score >= 30 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'low' END <> risk_level

assertions.name: 重算风险分与存储分无漂移
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_attacker_profile_summary WHERE stored_risk_score <> calculated_risk_score

assertions.name: 行数 = attack_log 有事件日期数
assertions.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_daily_attack_trend) - (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(event_time)) FROM attack_log)

assertions.name: 日期列无 NULL
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_daily_attack_trend WHERE stat_date IS NULL

assertions.name: 逐日事件数与 attack_log 按日聚合同值
assertions.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT DATE(event_time) AS d, COUNT(*) AS c FROM attack_log GROUP BY DATE(event_time) ) AS l LEFT JOIN v_daily_attack_trend AS v ON v.stat_date = l.d WHERE v.stat_date IS NULL OR v.event_count <> l.c) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_daily_attack_trend AS v LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(event_time) AS d, COUNT(*) AS c FROM attack_log GROUP BY DATE(event_time) ) AS l ON l.d = v.stat_date WHERE l.d IS NULL)

assertions.name: 查询事件总数 = attack_log 查询行数
assertions.sql: SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(query_count), 0) FROM v_daily_attack_trend) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attack_log WHERE event_type = 'query')

assertions.name: 行数 = 规则编码数
assertions.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_rule_effectiveness) - (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rule_code) FROM detection_rules)

assertions.name: 规则编码无 NULL
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_rule_effectiveness WHERE rule_code IS NULL

assertions.name: 命中总数 = rule_hits 行数
assertions.sql: SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(hit_count), 0) FROM v_rule_effectiveness) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rule_hits)

assertions.name: 告警总数 = alerts 行数
assertions.sql: SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(alert_count), 0) FROM v_rule_effectiveness) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alerts)
